messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick heads-up — candidate (SWE II) scheduled tomorrow 10:00am PT. Can we do a 9:30 dry run for the panel? camera/audio + recording check.
Samir Patel: I can make 9:30. But if oncall pager pops I might need a 5min buffer.
Jordan Li: I can join. Can someone confirm Zoom link + whether we want a breakout room for the pair task?
People Ops Bot: Reminder — please upload the evaluation rubric before the interview or choose 'defer' in the panel flow.
Maria Gomez: Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890  pass: r4w  — pairing in main room, we'll record.
Aisha Khan: thx Maria. Samir — would you scribe the debrief? we rotate scribes.
Samir Patel: happy to scribe. Quick rubric q: are we using technical 70 / org-fit 20 / communication 10 or did we change that?
Jordan Li: In last hiring sync we floated 70/15/15 but didn't finalize. Our canonical scorecard still 70/20/10.
Aisha Khan: Let's stick with the canonical 70/20/10 tomorrow for consistency across panels. If anyone wants to pilot 70/15/15 note it in the debrief.
Maria Gomez: Pairing plan: 30m pair task + 10m Qs. Candidate will share screen; panel asks clarifying q's only, no hints.
Jordan Li: For clarity, use the 'no-hints' rule except for clarifying questions. Document any nudges in notes.
Samir Patel: Also pinging infra for ephemeral VM access: @eng-infra-bot can you confirm test VM and creds flow?
eng-infra-bot: VM provisioned: vm-2026-hire-17. Creds sent to panel leads via 1Password. :white_check_mark:
Aisha Khan: Thanks. Runbook snippet for dry run (copy/paste):
```
1) 9:25 join Zoom, check mic/camera
2) 9:28 start recording and confirm participants can see candidate share
3) 9:30 quick walkthrough of pair task instructions (1-2 mins)
4) 9:32 start pair task timer (30m)
```
Samir Patel: I'll manage the timer. After interview: can we capture 3 bullets (strengths/concerns) + pass/hold/decline? Keep it short.
Jordan Li: +1. Also remind panel to avoid numerical calibration in chat — use final rubric only.
People Ops Bot: Post-interview checklist — upload rubrics & notes within 24h. Late submissions may delay hiring decisions.
Aisha Khan: If anything goes sideways (AV/recording fails), call the fallback policy: continue with non-recorded interview and note incident in debrief.
Maria Gomez: One last check — accessibility accommodation: candidate requested extended time if needed. We approved pre-interview. Panel keep in mind.
Samir Patel: Noted. I'll flag shorter segments if candidate needs pauses.
Jordan Li: :thumbsup: Good plan. Dry run 9:30, interview 10:00. See you all.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team — see you tomorrow.
Maria Gomez: Good luck candidate!
People Ops Bot: Thanks for coordinating. This thread will be archived after interview is complete.
